Tune in to this black & white classic song Zulmi Hamare Saawariya from the movie Mr. X in Bombay (1964) starring Kishore Kumar and Kumkum in the lead...
Credits:-
Movie: Mr. X in Bombay
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Cast: Kishore Kumar, Kumkum, Madan Puri
Director: Shantilal Soni
